installInsectProtectionMesh.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create one production-quality square transparent action illustration for the Gredice gardening game. Use the supplied pruning icon, backpack, and wooden raised bed as style references. Match their tactile matte materials, bold beveled low-poly forms, broad facets, honey and umber wood, fresh leaf greens, shaded sides, and soft warm upper-left light. Use one compact coherent arrangement with the material and the operation below unmistakable at thumbnail scale.
For Postavljanje zaštitne mreže protiv kukaca, depict a warm honey-wood raised bed with three lively green seedlings, entirely covered by a low cream-green hoop structure. A fine sage-teal open insect netting covers every side and the roof, hugging two low round arches and visibly fastened to all bed edges. Render the mesh as a light semi-transparent blue-green woven veil with sparse clearly legible crossing diamond strands, green leaves and dark soil clearly showing through it. It is soft textured open fabric with thin stitched hems, never a solid white cloth and never shiny glass or plastic. A green wooden rim and two amber fastening clips pin the net at the bed. The arc-shaped installed mesh above the rich green plants is the focal point. No pest characters, fabric roll or uncovered end.
Slightly elevated three-quarter view; entire subject centered with clear space around its full silhouette, readable at 48 px. Genuine transparent alpha wherever there is no subject and in open gaps. No backdrop, landscape, ground plane or cast shadow, text, numbers, arrows, symbols, watermarks, people, or hands.
installInsectProtectionMesh.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
